pr_body:
We are currently allowing implementers of `AggregatorTestCase` to provide their own IndexSearcher. THis can be done using `AggregatorTestCase#newIndexSearcher` which provides our own IndexSearcher implementation or using `LucenTestCase#newSearcher` which provides a Lucene implementation.

The issue is that at the moment both implementation are different and the current lucene implementation is not good enough for us when running in concurrent mode which is making the test less realistics. 

Therefore we propose to hide the creation of the index searcher from the implementers by changing the signature of `AggregatorTestCase#searchAndReduce` and `AggregatorTestCase#createAggregationContext` to take an IndexReader instead of an IndexSearcher. In addition `AggregatorTestCase#newIndexSearcher` is private now.

relates https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98672
fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98892

review_comment: Should this be marked as deprecated too?

` * Deprecated - this will be made private in a future update`

I don't think so, this method will stay as we still need to construct those objects in order to run aggregations. It will be internal so we control the life cycle of those objects.
